claim.claim-text: 2. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 1, wherein the battery assembly comprises a battery cover, a battery, and an upper housing, the upper housing covers an upper portion of the interior of the housing; the battery is arranged inside the upper housing; and the battery cover covers an upper portion of the battery to form a battery accommodating bin together with the upper housing.

3. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 2, wherein the control board is arranged inside another side of the upper housing and electrically connected to the battery.

4. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 3, wherein one end of the exhaust and backflow channel is located inside the bottom end of the housing and connected to the exhaust pipe, and the other end of the exhaust and backflow channel is located outside the bottom end of the housing and connected to an opening of a fuel can.
5. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 4, wherein a seal plug sleeve is arranged inside the seal port, and the seal plug sleeve is arranged inside the housing.

6. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 5, wherein each of the first connection kit, the second connection kit, and the third connection kit is composed of a connection sleeve, a sleeve pipe, and a seal ring.

7. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 6, wherein a nut connector is arranged at an exterior of the second connection kit in a sleeve manner and used for being fixedly connected to an opening of a fuel can.
8. The anti-siphonage and anti-overflow fuel pump structure according to claim 7, wherein the exhaust valve is a one-way soft rubber exhaust valve.
